achievements.name: Back from the Dead
achievements.description: Complete the tutorial - Sir Mordred is brought back from the dead.

achievements.name: Knights of the Cresenct Table
achievements.description: Find and Recruit 6 Hero Companions.

achievements.name: Ultra-Heavy
achievements.description: Reach 150 HP with Sir Mordred.

achievements.name: Ready to Fight
achievements.description: Equip a character with Relic items in every slot (except potions).

achievements.name: Field Day
achievements.description: Complete a mission without any of your heroes losing HP or Vitality (except tutorial missions).

achievements.description: Find a hidden treasure.

achievements.description: Reach level 25 with one Hero.

achievements.description: Find and Recruit  12 Hero Companions.

achievements.name: Disciples of the Four Branches
achievements.description: Complete a mission with 4 different classes.

achievements.description: Finish a mission with the Black Knight with Vitality loss and at least 2 permanent injuries.

achievements.name: A Person of Principle
achievements.description: Reach maximum points in one of the four Moralities.

achievements.name: A Second Chance
achievements.description: Resurrect a Hero from the Crypt.

achievements.name: It's Only a Model
achievements.description: Build all available buildings in Camelot.

achievements.description: Unlock all upgrades for a building in Camelot.

achievements.description: Acquire 10,000 gold.

achievements.description: Acquire 5,000 building resources.

achievements.description: Apply Burning, Poison, Chill, Slow and Bleeding effects on one enemy.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies at once with the Cleave skill.

achievements.name: AvaLAN Party

achievements.description: Kill at least 5 enemies at the same time with a fire-based Arcanist spell.

achievements.name: Surprise Party
achievements.description: Apply 4 backstab attacks in a single turn.

achievements.name: Bloodbath
achievements.description: Inflict bleeding on 5 enemies in the same round.

achievements.name: Floor Sweep
achievements.description: Knockdown 3 enemies in one turn.

achievements.name: Fortune Favors Fools
achievements.description: Miss 3 attacks in a single turn.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy performing a surprise attack with an overwatch attack.

achievements.name: My Life for Camelot
